items.source: The CreateRelationshipStatementHolder holds the Cypher Statement to create a relationship as well as the optional properties that describe the relationship in case of more than a simple relationship. By holding the relationship creation cypher together with the properties, we can reuse the same logic in the Neo4jTemplate as well as in the ReactiveNeo4jTemplate.
items.translation: `CreateRelationshipStatementHolder` 持有用于创建关系的 Cypher 语句，以及在关系不止是简单关系时描述该关系的可选属性。通过将关系创建的 Cypher 语句与属性一同封装，我们可以在 `Neo4jTemplate` 以及 `ReactiveNeo4jTemplate` 中复用相同的逻辑。
菲利普·托勒，迈克尔·J·西蒙斯
